categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC)
categories.content: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC) refers to social media platforms and protocols that operate without a central authority over user data, content, or infrastructure.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: Chinese Meme
categories.content: Chinese meme coins are inspired by China memes, cultural elements, or internet phenomena.

categories.name: Christmas Themed
categories.content: Meme coins themed around Christmas, inspired by holiday traditions, symbols, and celebrations.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Guild and Scholarship
categories.content: Guilds are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that invests in NFTs like game assets and rent them out to players. Players who receive rented game items are known as scholars and can be said to receive a scholarship. Guilds are an important component in the play to earn (P2E) ecosystem as these games require an upfront investment capital for players to participate in.

categories.name: Solana Token-2022
categories.content: Solana Token-2022 is a new token standard on Solana that provides additional fungible and non-fungible token functionality.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.

categories.name: Four.meme Ecosystem (BNB Memes)
categories.content: Four.meme Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via four.meme on BNB Chain.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.
